sentences.text: Task 3 Katie is at the airport.
She is calling Dan to ask him to edit an article she has been working on.
There are three parts to Task 3.
In Part A, you have to correct some sentences.
In Part B, you have to provide labels for parts of a painting and in Part C you have to complete a text.
You now have 30 seconds to study Task 3.
At the end of the task, you will have one minute to tidy up your answers.
Part A. Each line of the text below may have one mistake.
Correct the mistake as shown below.
If the line is correct then put a tick in the right hand column.
The first has been provided as an example.
Hello. Oh hi Dan.
Hi, where are you?
I'm at the airport.
Look Dan. I’ve written this article about games and art but didn’t have time to finish editing it, and like an idiot, I forgot my laptop.
I need you to check some things for me.
Can you open up the file?
It’s in the Dropbox folder.
Sure. OK. Let me just open it up.
Right, I’m ready.
OK, at the start of the article I discuss a famous painting called Children’s Games by Peter Bruegel the Elder.
It says here that it leaves a drawing.
Hmm. That should be a painting.
Can you change it?
OK. Done. Okay.
OK, now can you double check some of the facts are written correctly?
I might have got the dates wrong.
So please change it to 1560 if that’s printed incorrectly.
No, no. It’s right.
You say here that it was started in 1560.
Ah, just as well you said that.
It was completed then.
Oh and check that I’ve spelled the artist’s first name right.
It should be Peter Bruegel and Peter spelled P -I -E -T -E -R.
Oh you’ve actually written Pete Bruegel, P -E -T -E.
Oh, Thought so.
OK let me just change that now.
OK. Right, and make sure I’ve got the countries right.
I can never remember where he was born and died.
He died in Belgium and was born in the Netherlands.
Got it? Yeah I think so.
Part B. Label the four games the children are playing in the painting.
Use no more than four words for each.
OK, now the next thing is that I’ve put some labels on the painting to point out interesting details about what the children are actually doing the games they’re playing, I mean.
I didn’t manage to finish them.
Could you add them as I go through them?
Yes, let’s see.
I've got the picture up here now.
So, if you look closely, there’s one boy sitting cross legged on the grass.
Well, this was actually a form of exercise at the time, a bit like yoga today.
OK, I can see that now.
It does look like he’s doing a yoga exercise.
I didn’t realize before.
Also, in the picture, there are girls holding a basket.
Oh yes. I see them.
Seems to be a basket of fruit or something.
So what are they doing then?
It doesn’t look like a game.
Well, they’re actually performing a wedding.
A pretend wedding.
Oh, I remember having to dress up for pretend weddings when I was little with my big sister.
Oh, now that would be a wedding picture I'd love to see!
Yeah, well. Now, what else?
OK, you see those boys on top of the fence?
Well, they’re playing at riding horses.
Oh yes. I can see that now.
They really do look like they are riding a horse.
course. So what about the kids jumping over the other kid’s legs.
What’s that about?
This game's actually quite painful.
The children would apparently kick very hard and it would really hurt.
Ouch! So it’s a kicking game!
I’m glad we didn’t play that when I was at school.
We did something similar actually.
Kicking people I mean.
It was quite violent.
Part C. Complete the text.
Write one or more words in each gap.
Right, moving on.
What else is there?
Oh yes, at the end of the article there’s a section on present day games.
Games that use classic art for their graphics.
I didn’t quite finish that.
Oh, OK. They look fun.
Yeah, I loved reading up on this.
I like the fact that they're making a video game out of a classic work of art like The Last Supper or The Mona Lisa.
Yeah, I know.
They’re brilliant aren't they.
So what’s interesting is that these games use 8 -bit graphics.
8 bit? You mean like early computer graphics?
Why is 8 -bit graphics?
That’s a bit weird.
Well, because for the game designers it’s a challenge.
They’re trying to use these little blocks with only a few colours to create very complex pictures.
Hmm. What I mean is that they, the designers of these computer games, enjoy making these really complicated images from small blocks using only a small number of colours.
Yeah, OK. Well, Let me just finish making a note of that.
Right, keep going.
So the games themselves are actually quite simple, like really really simple and there’s a reason for that.
And what's the reason?
Well, these games are not meant to be serious.
They’re just supposed to be funny.
You mean humorous funny?
Not weird funny?
Yeah exactly. Like a joke.
And where can you find these games?
Do you have to pay for them?
You can get them on the Internet.
The good thing is they’re free.
You don’t need to pay anything.
Free. Well, that makes a change.
Maybe I'll check them out.
Is that everything?
Yes, that’s all.
Thanks for helping out, Dan.
